email_subject: Application - Customer Success Manager at daidalo
email_body:
Dear daidalo team,

I'm applying for the Customer Success Manager role. Your mission to clean ATS data for recruitment agencies resonates with me—I've spent years helping clients get real value from their digital tools, and I'd love to bring that focus to daidalo.

In my current roles, I manage client websites and SEO projects end-to-end: onboarding, ongoing support, and ensuring they see measurable results. I'm comfortable with data and AI tools, and I've built and optimized sites in WordPress and Shopify, often acting as the bridge between technical execution and client goals. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I'm eager to work in an international, entrepreneurial team.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my hands-on experience and client-first mindset can contribute to daidalo's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear daidalo team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager position. Your work turning messy ATS data into real placements for recruitment agencies immediately caught my attention—it's a clear, impactful problem, and I'd love to help your clients succeed with it.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage the full client journey for website and SEO projects: from initial onboarding and setup to ongoing optimization and reporting. I work directly with clients to understand their needs, translate them into concrete actions, and ensure they see measurable value—whether that's improved search visibility, a well-structured site, or content that ranks. I'm comfortable with data and AI tools, using them daily to automate work and uncover insights, and I've built and maintained sites in WordPress and Shopify, often serving as the bridge between technical execution and client goals.

What draws me to daidalo is the early-stage, hands-on environment where I can own a portfolio and shape customer success. I'm proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy building lasting relationships. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I'm excited about the international ambitions. While I haven't worked in SaaS or recruitment specifically, I've quickly adapted to new tools and industries, and I'm eager to learn.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my client-focused experience and technical background can contribute to daidalo's growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Client-facing project management: onboarding, ongoing support, and reporting for website and SEO clients, ensuring measurable results.
• Data and AI proficiency: daily use of LLMs and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Semrush, Ahrefs) to drive client value.
• Technical web skills: WordPress, Shopify, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, enabling effective communication with product and technical teams.
• Relationship building: experience managing client expectations and translating needs into concrete actions.
• Multilingual: fluent English and Turkish, Dutch B1 writing, suited for international client base.
